advisor_body: Not a call center, not a booking portal. When you send an enquiry through this site, I'm the one who reads it and the one who replies. I write the travel blog too, so you can get a sense of how I think about a destination before you ever contact me.
advisor_heading: There's one person behind Voyage By Luna — and it's me.
services_subheading: Four kinds of trips I plan most often — though if yours isn't listed, just ask.
hero_subheading: I'm Soukeyna — I plan cruises, all-inclusive resorts, Disney trips and honeymoons for people who'd rather enjoy the trip than research it. One person, start to finish.
final_cta_heading: Tell me about the trip you're picturing.
why_advisor_heading: Why book with an advisor instead of a booking site?
process_heading: Planning a trip with me takes four steps
process_body: No long forms, no obligation, and nothing to pay to start the conversation.

process_steps.title: Tell me what you're picturing
process_steps.body: A place, a date, a vibe, a budget — even just "somewhere warm in March." Rough is fine. That's the whole first step.

process_steps.title: I come back with options
process_steps.body: I research and send you a short list that actually fits what you told me, with the real costs and the trade-offs spelled out.

process_steps.title: We refine it together
process_steps.body: Swap the resort, move the dates, add a night. We go back and forth until it's the trip you actually want.

process_steps.title: You travel, I stay reachable
process_steps.body: I handle the booking and stay available before and during the trip if anything needs sorting out.

why_advisor_body: Anyone can search flights online. What a search engine can't do is know your family, read the fine print for you, or pick up the phone when a flight gets cancelled at 11pm. That's the job.

why_advisor_points.title: One point of contact
why_advisor_points.body: You tell me what you want once. I line up the flights, hotels, transfers and details so they actually fit together.

why_advisor_points.title: No extra cost to you
why_advisor_points.body: Travel advisors are typically paid by the travel suppliers, not by you — so personalized planning usually costs the same as booking it yourself.

why_advisor_points.title: A real person when plans change
why_advisor_points.body: Delays, cancellations and changes happen. You call me, not an airline hold queue.

final_cta_body: Share a few details and I'll follow up personally — no obligation, no pressure.
destinations_subheading: A few destinations I know well and get asked about often.
